key_decisions: ONE GRAPH, TWO MODES. The bench proved the design as two files whose WIRING differed, so neither could ship. Three MpiAnySwitch nodes on Input_Mode pick the crop source, reference 2 and the baked instruction. Do not re-split it.

Input_Paint carries image2 and the GRAPH fans it out. A third image input was tried and CANNOT work: commandExecutor._buildParams keys `assigned` by slot.key, so one role can never fill two titles (the MPI-292 dedup says the same from the other side). Feeding the manual arm from Input_Paint is pixel-identical and drops a node.

The place step reports a MAP - { region, mode } - so it binds `param: { region: "box1", mode: "Input_Mode" }`. Binding a place step with the string form writes [object Object] into one node, silently, and the run still finishes.

The prompt field renders in AUTO as well as Manual, deliberately: it is live there (node 18 concatenates Input_Positive onto whichever instruction the switch picked) and scene lighting is useful in both. Hiding it in Auto is OPEN and not free - the mode radio lives inside MpiStepPlace, so mode-conditional visibility needs a gizmo->frame seam that does not exist.
constraints: NEVER write preview/video into the FlowDef before the art files exist. A declared name with no file 404s, and tests/desktop/flows-tab-ring.spec.js asserts a clean console in three places - that held master RED for a day and eight pushes.

Commit the art BEFORE anyone runs scripts/sync-raw-workflows.mjs: its guard refuses on any dirty path under comfy_workflows/ outside raw/, and blocks a peer with a message naming neither your file nor art.
Step ORDER in the FlowDef is load-bearing and fails SILENTLY - `cutout` must stay declared before `place`, or stage 3 stamps the UNCUT object and the run still returns a picture.

A peer has UNCOMMITTED work in this tree (js/data/modelConstants/nodesDeps.js, comfy_workflows/flow_chatter_box.json, board.json, MPI-249 and MPI-595 card files). Commit by explicit pathspec only; never git add -A.

The bench (8188) was left RUNNING and is on 0.31.0, which matches the node_lock pin - that is why converting against it was safe this session. Never point anything at 48188 (the app engine) or :3000 (Fabio live session).
